title: El fin de semana
blurbEn: The last text of the unit. Ana's weekend looks nothing like her weekdays — and you meet the irregular verb 'ir'.
body:
Los sábados no trabajo. Me levanto tarde y desayuno despacio.

Por la mañana voy al parque con mis amigos.

Los domingos descanso en casa. A veces cocino para mi familia.

El fin de semana pasa rápido.
translationEn:
On Saturdays I do not work. I get up late and have breakfast slowly.

In the morning I go to the park with my friends.

On Sundays I rest at home. Sometimes I cook for my family.

The weekend passes quickly.

al.note: 'a' + 'el' always squashes together into 'al'. You never write 'a el'.

voy.note: 'ir' is completely irregular — 'voy' looks nothing like it. Learn this one by heart.

phrases.note: 'los' + a day means 'every' that day. No word for 'on' is needed.
